name: Jerusalem
overview: Scripture presents Jerusalem as a significant and fortified city with a rich history of kings and conflicts, as seen in the account of Adonizedek, king of Jerusalem, who allied with other kings to wage war against Gibeon after it made peace with Israel (Joshua 10:1-5). Additionally, Jerusalem is connected to the priestly and kingly figure Melchizedek, king of Salem, who served as a priest of the Most High God, highlighting the city's spiritual importance (Genesis 14:18). These passages reveal Jerusalem as both a political stronghold and a place of divine priesthood, setting the stage for its central role in God's redemptive plan.
